summary: TNL Mediagene filed a Form 6-K reporting the full repayment of its Second Senior Convertible Note ($1,666,667 principal, $1.5M net after 10% OID) to 3i, LP on July 8, 2026, including $150,000 accrued interest. On July 23, 2026, the parties entered a Termination Agreement mutually ending the Securities Purchase Agreement (SPA) and related agreements, with mutual releases. The note had been partially repaid in shares (3,381,700 ordinary shares). A warrant and an Ordinary Share Purchase Agreement with Tumim Stone Capital remain in effect. The Termination Agreement grants the Note Investor a 25% participation right in any Subsequent Financing for one year. Watch for potential new financings triggering this right.
